name: Hex: Overture of Doom

description.content: When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.
After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for [5s]:

items: For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.

description.content: When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.

quote: "From salvation's ruin, be warned/death comes from all around." -Giovanni Serrata's Fog Hill
